notes: Safer stop handling and clearer alerts when a bracket order is rejected.
changelog: Breakeven and trailing only ever tighten a stop, and never move it to or through the market.
If a stop is rejected or cancelled by the broker after your brackets are placed, you now get a popup and a sound saying the position may be unprotected.
A target dragged behind the current price is refused instead of filling at once and closing your position.
Shift+drag keeps working after you switch the chart to another instrument, and releasing Shift before the mouse button cancels the drag with a message.
Preview lines sit exactly under the cursor, and Chart Trader buttons no longer duplicate after a recompile or when switching tabs.
The settings window checks bracket-set percentages and preset names before saving.
